lesson_ratings.title: Living for the Moment
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces varied vocabulary about living fully, with useful phrases like 'dance my heart out' and 'spend it like no other'.

lesson_ratings.title: That Crush
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches real words and expressions such as 'crush', 'rush', 'gave it up', and 'say too much'.

lesson_ratings.title: Dancing Till Dawn
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact reprise of lesson 1; no new words to learn.

lesson_ratings.title: Gave It Up
lesson_ratings.reason: Offers new idioms like 'stay in touch', 'went bust', 'no tricks, no bluff', and 'better off'.

lesson_ratings.title: Back in the Groove
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains useful expressions: 'get back in the groove', 'in a hurry', 'what matters is now'.

lesson_ratings.title: All Night, All Summer
lesson_ratings.reason: Another exact reprise of lesson 1; no new content.

lesson_ratings.title: Another Crush
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces 'blush', 'second time is once too much', and reinforces 'crush' and 'rush' in a new context.

lesson_ratings.title: Till the Dawn
lesson_ratings.reason: Yet another reprise of lesson 1; adds nothing new.

lesson_ratings.title: Second Time
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact reprise of lesson 7; no new vocabulary.
